title: BakaCraft
description: Did you ever want to lookup a random manga or light novel while playing Minecraft? No? Alright... Welp, now you can!
body:
Ever been deep in the mines, fighting off a horde of zombies, and suddenly thought: _"Man, I really need to know the plot of that one isekai manga right this second"_?

Probably not. But I built a plugin for it anyway!

BakaCraft hooks up to the MangaBaka database and brings it straight into your Minecraft chat. Because pausing your game and alt-tabbing to a browser is entirely too much work.

What does this plugin do? Thanks for asking:
- In-Game Lookups: Search for any manga, manhwa, manhua, or light novel directly from the server.
- Instant Info: Get titles, synopses, and other info dropped right into your chat feed.
- Stay Alive: Never lose your hardcore world to a creeper just because you were busy looking up what to read next.

The usage? It's really simple:
> Just type `/baka search <type|all> [title]` and let the server do the rest.
> 
> If you know a specific ID (I recommend checking out ID 5258, definitely not one of the authors of that series), you can look it up directly via `/baka view [entry_id]`

To install, drop it into your plugins folder, restart, and embrace peak laziness.
